doctrine:
POOR CHARLIE'S ALMANACK - FULL DISTILLATION

## MASTER FRAME: Worldly Wisdom
Real problem-solving requires a latticework of 80-100 mental models drawn from hard disciplines (math > physics > chemistry > biology > psychology > economics). A single discipline produces man-with-a-hammer syndrome. Cross-check every major decision against models from at least three unrelated fields. Rank by fundamentalness: never explain in soft ways what reduces to fundamentals. Give full attribution; avoid sloppy filing.

## THE 25 PSYCHOLOGICAL TENDENCIES (Live Checklist)
Run every negotiation, pitch, acquisition, hiring decision, and major strategic move through all 25:
1. Reward/Punishment Superresponse - incentives reshape behavior subconsciously; design before deploying
2. Liking/Loving - love-bias distorts assessment of loved objects/people
3. Disliking/Hating - mirror of above; distorts downward
4. Doubt-Avoidance - mind wants to resolve uncertainty fast; premature closure
5. Inconsistency-Avoidance - early conclusions resist updating (Darwin antidote: force disconfirming search)
6. Curiosity - net positive; cultivate it
7. Kantian Fairness - reciprocity norm triggers sharp reactions to perceived unfairness
8. Envy/Jealousy - underacknowledged driver; socially taboo, operationally real
9. Reciprocation - concession-sequence weapon: ask massive first, then smaller ask (2x-3x compliance). Antidote: Walton absolute prohibition on vendor favors
10. Influence-from-Mere-Association - separate past successes for accidental factors before redeploying; challenge love-bias
11. Simple Pain/Pleasure Avoiding (Denial) - bad news suppressed; cultivate bad-news welcome culture
12. Excessive Self-Regard - hire by past record not face-to-face impression; downweight interviews; force objectivity on self/family/possessions
13. Overoptimism - train habitual Fermat-Pascal probability math; evolutionary heuristics insufficient for modern risk
14. Deprival-Super-Reaction (Loss Aversion) - loss > gain (asymmetric); almost-lost triggers same as actual-lost; labor trap: resistance to wage takeaways business-destroying; Buffett rule: avoid auctions; poker teaches folding antidote
15. Social-Proof - triggers most in puzzlement + stress; bad behavior contagious; isolation + stress = sales/cult tool; bystander effect; boards passively inactive until public shame
16. Contrast-Misreaction - show 3 bad at high price then bad at moderate high = sale; artificial anchoring; slow-step disaster: tiny contrast misses trend-as-destiny (boiling frog)
17. Stress-Influence - light stress improves performance; heavy causes dysfunction; Pavlov dogs: extreme stress causes breakdown; reversal requires reimposing stress, not relief
18. Availability-Misweighting - antidotes: checklists, Darwin disconfirming evidence, skeptical advocates; vivid overweighted, underweight vivid intentionally; use vivid constructively for persuasion
19. Use-It-or-Lose-It - all skills attenuate with disuse; aircraft-simulator continuous practice of rarely-used skills; checklist assembles skills into routines; fluency (not cramming) slows loss
20. Drug Misinfluence - chemical distortion of cognition
21. Senescence-Misinfluence - cognitive decline with age
22. Authority-Misinfluence - automatic follow-the-leader overcomes logic; copilot simulators teach ignoring foolish boss (yet still fail); board antidote: careful appointments
23. Twaddle Tendency - incoherent communication in unnatural situations; keep twaddle-producers far from serious work
24. Reason-Respecting - people learn and comply better given correct reasons; Carl Braun rule: every order must include Who/What/Where/When/Why; even meaningless reasons increase compliance (conditioned reflex); exploited by commercial/cult practitioners
25. Lollapalooza - extreme results from confluence of multiple tendencies acting same direction; not in psychology texts; dominates real life (Milgram, cults, crashes); academic gap: compound effects ignored

contradictions: OS uses 'trust your gut on people' framing in several places: book explicitly contradicts this. Hire by past record; downweight face-to-face impression entirely. Interview is low-predictive-value. OS should flag this as a live error in people decisions.

OS has no explicit second/third-order effects audit gate: Munger flags this as one of nine economics defects (Medicare 1000% forecast error). Any OS decision about pricing, hiring, or outreach should run a second/third-order pass that currently is not built.

Febezzlement concept absent from OS capital-allocation frame: OS treats investment/tool spend as neutral. Munger argues cost waste creates phantom wealth effects that distort real performance reading. SNIPED should audit tool/subscription spend for febezzlement drift.

OS does not distinguish the 4 extreme success pattern types when designing offers or lanes. It conflates optimization (type A), lollapalooza (type B), multi-factor excellence (type C), and wave-riding (type D). Each requires different resource allocation strategy.

OS uses authority signals (lineage, credibility markers) as trust-building tools without flagging authority-misinfluence risk: the same signals can trigger uncritical compliance in buyers and partners, which Munger marks as an ethical risk when exploited rather than earned.
chunk_accuracy_note: Existing chunks captured the high-level frame accurately (latticework, inversion, 25 biases, lollapalooza, incentive-caused bias, circle of competence, social proof, compounding, ideology warning). However: (1) The 25 biases were named but not individually actionable - each bias's specific antidote and operating mechanism was missing. (2) Nine economics defects were entirely absent from chunks. (3) Extreme success pattern taxonomy (4 types) was absent. (4) Carl Braun communication rule was absent. (5) Darwin anti-bias protocol was absent as a named executable. (6) Coca-Cola case study as a proof-of-method was absent. (7) Febezzlement concept was absent. (8) Specific antidotes for deprival-super-reaction, contrast-misreaction, availability-misweighting, authority-misinfluence were absent. (9) Duplicate concepts appeared (inversion listed twice, circle of competence listed twice) indicating the chunking process lost deduplication discipline. Chunks are accurate as far as they go but miss approximately 40% of the actionable operating content.
skill_candidates: munger-25-bias-audit: Executable checklist pass - run all 25 psychological tendencies against any major SNIPED decision (hire, offer, outreach, pricing, acquisition) before committing. Returns a bias-flagged decision memo.

munger-inversion-pass: Given any initiative or strategic question, run forward analysis + inverted failure-mode analysis, return both side-by-side with lollapalooza flag if 3+ failure modes share a root.
gate_candidates: second-third-order-effects gate: Before any pricing change, hiring decision, or outreach sequence goes live, require explicit second and third-order effect analysis. Blocks deployment until completed.
hire-by-record gate: No hire or key contractor decision proceeds based on interview impression alone. Past record audit required. Interview impression explicitly downweighted in decision memo.
workflow_candidates: braun-communication-standard: All SNIPED orders, directives, outreach templates, and SOPs pass a Who/What/Where/When/Why completeness check before sending. Incomplete = not sent.

vendor-favor-prohibition: Standing Walton rule applied to all SNIPED vendor relationships. Any gifting, favor-offering, or relationship-building from vendors triggers an explicit conflict-of-interest audit before the vendor relationship continues.
